import json, select, sys, time
from guala_body_load_release import LOADS, prior_records, run_case
prior = prior_records()
for h in (100, 50, 25):
    for index, (name, sign) in enumerate(LOADS):
        record = run_case(name, sign, h, prior)
        payload = json.dumps(record, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        print("BEGIN " + json.dumps({"step_us": h, "load_index": index, "chars": len(payload)}), flush=True)
        for start in range(0, len(payload), 10000):
            print("CHUNK " + payload[start:start+10000], flush=True)
            ready, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], 60)
            if not ready or sys.stdin.readline().strip() != "ACK":
                raise RuntimeError("bounded diagnostic output acknowledgement missing")
        print("END " + json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k != "payload_zlib_base64"}), flush=True)
print("COMPLETE", flush=True)
